options.text: I need to file this deed.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Form 12-C requires a boundary by survey. Your deed says 'from the stake, thereabouts.'

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Thereabouts is not a unit, Mr. Grubb. I have checked.

options.text: Where would I find a surveyor?

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: The territory licenses surveyors. Consolation has none. The statute accepts a boundary 'attested in good form by any person holding a trade license from this office.'

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: I have issued one license this year. It was to a diviner.

options.say: Then the deed, the survey and the fee. In that order. The order is in the statute, so that nobody can say he paid for the paper.

options.text: The deed's drawn wrong side up.
options.say: Statute does not specify an orientation. You would be surprised how much statute does not specify. I would not. I have read it.

repeats.say: It still does not specify. I have read it again since you asked.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Pike, Ezra. Claim filed in forty-nine. Lapsed in fifty-two, on account of the claimant.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: The undertaker holds the rest of the file.

repeats.say: Lapsed. The undertaker has the remainder of the file.

options.say: Lapsed, Mr. Grubb. In this office we say lapsed.

repeats.say: Lapsed. It is a perfectly good word. It has a form.

options.text: Is there a form for that?
options.say: There is a form for everything, Mr. Grubb. That is the point of forms.

SUM_B1.prompt: C is the certificate. It cannot require itself. That would be circular, and this office is linear.

opening.speaker: thad
opening.line: I'd like to see how Claim One was filed. We're neighbors now.

opening.speaker: sump
opening.line: Neighbors may view a sealed filing on a Certificate of Contiguity. Document C. It is issued on presentation of Documents A, B and D.

opening.speaker: sump
opening.line: C is the certificate. It cannot require itself. That would be circular, and this office is linear.

options.say: The Affidavit of Original Sale. Sworn by the vendor. The office does not require the vendor to be found. It requires him to sign.

repeats.say: Sworn by the vendor. Signed by the vendor. Found, optionally.

options.say: The Assay of Record, from the Assay Office, on its own form. It need not find anything. It need only be issued.

repeats.say: Issued, Mr. Grubb. Not found. Issued.

options.say: Proof of Continuous Occupancy. Ninety days, attested by a neighbor. The office accepts one neighbor. It does not inquire into his character. It has never found that useful.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Present A, B and D together and the office issues C, the Certificate of Contiguity. It is the only document that comes after D. I find that restful.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: He brings Claim One's filing to the window, under its glass.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Claim One. Obadiah Mott, eighteen forty-six. 'The richest strike in the history of this territory, lying at the place herein described.'

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: Where is it described?

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Herein.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: He turns the glass over. The back of the sheet is blank.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: The office accepted it. It was a busy year.

options.text: Who else may see a sealed filing?
options.say: Sealed filings are open to the court, to the claimholder, and to the executor of a deceased claimholder. Section nineteen. You are none of these, Mr. Grubb, and only one of them is beyond your control.

repeats.say: The court, the claimholder, the executor of a deceased claimholder. Section nineteen has not changed since you asked. It is not that kind of section.

options.text: Do you ever stamp anything just for the pleasure of it?
options.say: Pleasure is not a ground. I stamp on grounds.

repeats.say: Still not a ground. I have consulted the statute, in case.

options.text: I've taken enough of your time. I'll be taking more later.

SUM_E1.prompt: Mr. Grubb. You have the look of a man with a petition.

opening.speaker: sump
opening.line: Mr. Grubb. You have the look of a man with a petition.

options.text: I'd like Obadiah Mott declared dead.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Seven years' absence, which Mr. Mott has comfortably achieved, and a petitioner with standing: kin, or a creditor. Mr. Mott has no kin on file, and he owes nobody.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: It is the most suspicious thing about him.

options.text: Section nineteen. The executor of a deceased claimholder.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: May open the archive. Correct.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: I hold a claim.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: You do.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: If I were deceased—

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Your executor would have the archive, and you would have a plot.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: An executor may hold no interest in any claim touching the estate. Sub-section two. It was written after a family in Placerville.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: The office does not advise. It answers.

options.say: It is the only thing in Consolation that requires no form in advance. Afterward there are several.

repeats.say: No form in advance. I have checked again. I find it a serious gap.

options.text: I am going to leave now, in a dignified manner.

options.text: I have a death to record. Mine.
options.say: The office does not require the deceased to be absent. An oversight, possibly. I do not correct statute. I administer it.
I know what is certified, Mr. Grubb. It is the only kind of knowing this window does.

options.text: Is there a form for this?
options.say: Form 31-D. Notice of Decease, Self-Reported. Nobody has used it before. It was printed in hope.

repeats.say: 31-D. You are the first. I have made a note of it for the next printing.

options.text: Thank you. This has been clarifying.

SUM_F1.prompt: Form 12-C, Amended. Location of Claim One. And the holder's name, in the holder's box.

opening.speaker: sump
opening.line: Form 12-C, Amended. Location of Claim One. And the holder's name, in the holder's box.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: …That's a very old claim number.

exchange.speaker: winnie
exchange.line: You're putting it in his name.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: Yes.

exchange.speaker: winnie
exchange.line: You understand you get nothing.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: I get to stop lying. I've only just learned how and I'm already tired of it.

exchange.speaker: winnie
exchange.line: stamping

exchange.speaker: winnie
exchange.line: …Certified.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: reading, toneless

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Amended location, Claim One. Holder, Obadiah Mott. 'The strike lies at the place herein described.'

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Which is now described.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: Under statute, a claim must be worked by its holder within thirty days, or it reverts to the Territory.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: So Mr. Mott will have to come forward.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: In person. To this window. Within thirty days.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: He blots it.

exchange.speaker: sump
exchange.line: I shall look forward to it.

options.say: Claim One is Mr. Mott's. You may file on his behalf. Not in your favor.

repeats.say: Still Mr. Mott's. The box does not take hopes.

exchange.speaker: winnie
exchange.line: I said don't.

exchange.speaker: winnie
exchange.line: Don't you dare.

options.say: The raccoon holds no license from this office.

repeats.say: Still unlicensed, Mr. Grubb. It has never applied.
